👍 UPDATE AT 275K LIKES! 👍

🌟 Welcome to Tower of Fun! Try and beat this awesome randomly generated tower within the timer! Beat stages to get coins, which you can use to buy mutators, effects, and more! Do you have what it takes?

🎅 Christmas Update [12/17]
- 🔨 Checkpoints should be fixed in new servers
- 🔨 Winners no longer speed the round up for everyone else
- 🌟 5 new stages
- 🎅 Festive season is here!
- 🐶 Christmas pack on sale!
- ✨ Tower visual changes & improvements
- 🦘 Double jump
- 👍 Easy mode (gives immunity to all lava)
- 🔨 UI Changes & improvements

⚠️ - SHUTDOWN = BUG FIXES / UPDATE
🚨 BIG UPDATES VERY OFTEN - Make sure to check back often!
👍 - Likes and favorites show us great support and we are so thankful!
